title: Ammunition ballistics

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

units.description: Unit of every distance in the file. Speeds are meters per second.

id.description: Projectile id from the game, for example `Item.Caliber.556mm`.

asset.description: Path of the projectile data asset inside the game files.

damage.description: Damage of one hit before distance falloff, armor and hit location.

damageContext.description: Extra damage context tags, for example the body parts the type is tuned for.

drag.description: Aerodynamic drag: the coefficient and, when the game names one, the drag model it comes from (such as G7).

model.description: Name of the drag model (a row of the game's drag table), for example `G7 (Boat Tail)`.

typicalSpeed.description: The speed the game treats as typical for the projectile. Weapons set their own muzzle velocity.

penetration.description: How the projectile behaves against surfaces. Absent when the game defines nothing.

penetrates.description: False when the projectile never passes through surfaces. Absent when the game does not say.

penetratesThinSurfaces.description: True when the projectile always passes through thin surfaces.

exitSpeedMultiplier.description: Fraction of the speed kept after passing through a surface.

effectivenessMultiplier.description: Multiplier on how well the projectile penetrates, as stored.

ricochetMinAngle.description: Impact angle in degrees above which the projectile ricochets.

explosive.description: Area damage. Absent for projectiles that do none.

radius.description: Distance at which damage has fallen to its minimum.

effectiveRadius.description: Distance within which full damage applies.

falloff.description: How fast explosive damage falls with distance, as stored.

propulsion.description: Set for rockets and missiles that keep accelerating or steer after launch.

thrustSpeed.description: Speed in meters per second the motor accelerates the projectile to.

guided.description: True when the projectile steers after launch.

items.description: Ammo items (ids from items.json) that fire this projectile.

Ammunition ballistics: one entry per projectile definition. Several ammo items can share one (the armor-piercing and hollow-point variants of a caliber use the same definition and differ in the damage rules, which are not extracted). Distances are meters, speeds meters per second, mass kilograms, size millimeters.

projectiles.description: One entry per projectile definition, sorted by id.

description: Ammunition ballistics: damage, size, drag, penetration and explosive data per projectile, with the ammo items that fire each one.
